description: Out-of-order migrations reviewed by a person and pinned to the exact file content (sha256 of the LF-normalised text). The migration-policy check accepts a version older than the base branch's newest ONLY while the file still hashes to the pinned value, so these files can stay byte-for-byte unchanged (they are already applied on Acceptance, which makes them immutable history) and any later edit fails the check. The `destructive` section does the same for a destructive-looking statement in an already-applied migration that cannot be edited to carry the destructive-reviewed marker.

Its only flagged statements are two `drop function if exists` of TRIGGER functions app.craftsman_review_guard() (added by 20261115090001 in this same unreleased stack, never on main or Production) and app.showroom_review_guard() (the completeness check on approval, removed by owner policy).
